competitions.result: Runners-up — lost 2–1 to Chelsea at Wembley.
Winners — beat Cardiff City 3–2 on penalties after a 2–2 draw.

overview: Liverpool won the League Cup and reached the FA Cup final under Kenny Dalglish. Cardiff City took the League Cup final to penalties after a 2–2 draw at Wembley on 26 February; Liverpool won the shoot-out 3–2. In the FA Cup, Andy Carroll scored the winner against Everton in the semi-final, but Chelsea won the final 2–1.

League results were less successful: Liverpool finished eighth with 52 points, scoring 47 goals and winning six of their 19 home matches. Jordan Henderson, Charlie Adam, Stewart Downing and José Enrique joined, while Craig Bellamy returned. Luis Suárez was leading scorer with 17 competitive goals.

The FA imposed an eight-match ban on Suárez after finding that he had used racially insulting language towards Patrice Evra. The season ended with Dalglish’s dismissal on 16 May, despite the League Cup success.
